items.title: Lithium constraints on India’s transport electrification: system-level impacts and policy implications for the net-zero transition
items.title_en: Lithium constraints on India’s transport electrification: system-level impacts and policy implications for the net-zero transition
items.title_zh: 锂资源对印度交通电气化的制约：系统层面的影响及对净零转型的政策启示
items.summary_en: Energy transition pathways have largely treated critical minerals as unconstrained for the deployment of low-carbon energy technologies. This paper challenges this assumption for India, the third-largest energy consumer globally and a major importer of battery-grade minerals, by incorporating lithium supply limitations within an integrated energy-system framework and quantifying the consequences on technology choices, electrification, and transition costs. This study assesses the feasibility of decarbonization pathways using the long-term energy-system models from a critical minerals availability constraints perspective. Using the KINESYS-TIMES model, seventeen scenarios combine three lithium-intensity sensitivities (kg of lithium per kWh of installed battery capacity) with four availability cases (30%, 60% and 90% of unconstrained net-zero (NZ) requirements, and unconstrained), two dynamic recycling variants, and three runs under an Accelerated Policies scenario of intermediate ambition. The availability is enforced within the optimization; hence the substitutability comes from cost minimization, not from post hoc accounting, and the marginal value of the constraint becomes apparent. Lithium retained in the operational fleet grows twentyfold between 2030 and 2070 from 36.8 to 728.4 kt yr−1 with post-2040 being the risk period. Under severe constraint, within the fixed lithium-ion technology set modelled, the system reconfigures rather than fails; electrification is throttled back, hydrogen and biofuels expand, and hybrids re-enter endogenously. Recycling contributes little prior to 2045 but increases availability to 452 from 218 kt yr−1 by 2070. The shadow price of the constraint is zero until the cap hits and then increases convexly, in the ratio 1.00:2.79:7.94 in 2070 for the three caps, and chemistry innovation delays the cap hit by fifteen years. Under the intermediate ambition, the binding cap is satisfied by 67.9% fossil fuels versus 10.6% under NZ. These results establish material feasibility as a structurally distinct dimension of India’s NZ pathway requiring explicit integration into energy planning alongside emissions and energy security.
items.summary_zh: 能源转型路径在很大程度上将关键矿物视为低碳能源技术部署中不受限制的因素。 本文针对印度——全球第三大能源消费国及电池级矿产的主要进口国——对这一假设提出了质疑：通过在综合能源系统框架内纳入锂供应限制因素，并量化其对技术选择、电气化进程及转型成本的影响。 本研究从关键矿产可用性约束的角度出发，利用长期能源系统模型评估了脱碳路径的可行性。 利用KINESYS-TIMES模型，十七种情景将三种锂强度敏感性（每千瓦时装机电池容量所需的锂公斤数）与四种可用性情况（分别占无约束净零（NZ）需求的30%、60%和90%，以及无约束）相结合， 两种动态回收变体，以及在中等雄心水平的“加速政策”情景下进行的3次模拟。可用性约束在优化过程中得到严格执行；因此，替代性源于成本最小化，而非事后核算，且该约束的边际价值也得以凸显。 2030年至2070年间，运营车队中保留的锂量增长了二十倍，从36.8千吨/年增至728.4千吨/年，其中2040年后是风险期。 在严苛约束下，在建模的固定锂离子技术组合范围内，系统会进行重组而非崩溃；电气化进程将放缓，氢能和生物燃料将扩大规模，混合动力车辆将内生性地重新进入市场。 在 2045 年之前，回收利用的贡献微乎其微，但到 2070 年，可用量将从 218 kt yr−1 增加到 452 kt yr−1。 在达到上限之前，该约束的影子价格为零，之后呈凸性增长，2070年三项上限的比率分别为1.00:2.79:7.94，而化学创新将使达到上限的时间推迟十五年。 在中等减排目标下，67.9%的化石燃料满足约束上限，而新西兰目标下这一比例仅为10.6%。这些资源

items.title: Observed sub-surface warming in Northern Eurasia (1963–2022)
items.title_en: Observed sub-surface warming in Northern Eurasia (1963–2022)
items.title_zh: 欧亚大陆北部观测到的地表以下变暖现象（1963–2022）
items.summary_en: Long-term soil temperature changes in high-latitude regions have been reported mainly focusing on the near-surface air and sub-surface soil temperature because of limited observational data. This gap still obscures spatiotemporal changes and associated processes of vertical thermal changes at multiple soil layers over such climate-sensitive regions. This study investigates changes of soil temperature across Northern Eurasia utilizing monthly temperature data at seven soil depth layers over 1963–2022. This study examines the past trends in the three coarse soil depth levels (up to one, two, and three meters below the surface) across seasons. Results indicate diversity in vertical thermal changes over Northern Eurasia. Most stations show statistically significant warming at near-surface air temperature on annual average, which are attributable to the substantial warming prevalence in boreal spring (96% of total stations) partially with relatively weak prevalence in boreal winter and autumn (47% and 55%, respectively). Surface warming is intensified in the deep soil layers within continuous-permafrost regions, particularly during boreal summer, showing a spring-to-summer shift in the vertical distribution of warming. The results indicate soil depth-dependent variations of warming trends in Northern Eurasia as a response to climate change. This study highlights the value of long-term multiple soil-depth temperature data as a reference for model evaluation over high latitude regions like Northern Eurasia.
items.summary_zh: 由于观测数据有限，此前关于高纬度地区长期土壤温度变化的研究主要集中于近地表空气和近地表土壤温度。这一空白仍使这些气候敏感地区多层土壤中垂直热变化的时空变化及其相关过程难以厘清。 本研究利用1963–2022年期间七个土壤深度层的月度温度数据，对北欧亚地区的土壤温度变化进行了调查。本研究考察了三个粗分土壤深度层（地表以下1米、2米和3米）在不同季节的过去趋势。 结果表明，北欧亚地区的垂直热变化呈现多样性。 大多数观测站显示，年平均近地表气温出现具有统计学意义的变暖，这归因于北半球春季普遍出现的显著变暖（占观测站总数的 96%），而北半球冬季和秋季的变暖现象相对较弱（分别占 47% 和 55%）。 在连续永久冻土区域内，深层土壤的变暖趋势更为显著，特别是在北半球夏季，这表明变暖的垂直分布发生了从春季向夏季的转变。 研究结果表明，作为对气候变化的响应，北欧亚地区的变暖趋势随土壤深度的增加而呈现差异。本研究突显了长期多深度土壤温度数据作为北欧亚等高纬度地区模型评估参考的价值。

items.title: A century of streamwater quality degradation by input from urban water infrastructure as revealed by tree-ring records
items.title_en: A century of streamwater quality degradation by input from urban water infrastructure as revealed by tree-ring records
items.title_zh: 树轮记录揭示：城市供水基础设施排放导致河流水质恶化已持续一个世纪
items.summary_en: The transfer of water from urban water networks to natural streams is a driver of streamwater quality degradation that likely occurs worldwide. We develop a new proxy using tree-ring strontium isotope ratios (87Sr/86Sr) to reconstruct multidecadal histories of municipal-water contributions to natural streams. We apply this approach to three watersheds spanning highly urbanized, rapidly urbanizing, and rural conditions in central Texas, USA. Municipal water has persistently dominated streamflow (>90%) in the urban watershed since at least 1945, only 25 years after the initial expansion of Austin’s municipal water infrastructure network. In the rapidly urbanizing watershed, the modeled municipal-water component of stream baseflow increased from approximately 12% to 33% over only 35 years- a 175% increase that coincided with an 85% increase in population density. In contrast, municipal-water contributions have remained low in the rural watershed since the 1840s. The timing of Sr isotope increases in the urban and rapidly urbanizing watersheds indicates that municipal-water contributions can substantially alter stream chemistry within just two decades of water infrastructure installation. This proxy allows the reconstruction of water-quality degradation over periods of urban growth in the 20th and 21st centuries, including periods that predate the initiation of modern water-quality monitoring. Our approach provides a tool for diagnosing the resilience of water infrastructure under accelerating urban growth and climate stress, informing proactive strategies to protect freshwater resources worldwide.
items.summary_zh: 城市供水网络向天然溪流的输水，是导致溪流水质恶化的驱动因素之一，这种情况很可能在全球范围内普遍存在。我们利用树轮中的锶同位素比值（87Sr/86Sr）开发了一种新的替代指标，用于重建市政供水对天然溪流影响的多十年历史。 我们将该方法应用于美国得克萨斯州中部三个分别代表高度城市化、快速城市化和农村环境的流域。自至少1945年以来——即奥斯汀市市政供水基础设施网络首次扩建仅25年后——市政供水在城市流域的径流中一直占据主导地位（>90%）。 在快速城市化流域中，经模型估算的市政用水在溪流基流中的占比，仅在35年内就从约12%上升至33%——增幅达175%，这与人口密度85%的增长相吻合。 相比之下，自1840年代以来，农村流域中市政用水的贡献比例一直较低。城市流域和快速城市化流域中锶同位素浓度上升的时间点表明，市政用水在供水基础设施建成后的短短二十年间，就能显著改变河流的化学成分。 这一替代指标使我们能够重建20世纪和21世纪城市化发展期间的水质恶化过程，包括现代水质监测启动之前的时期。我们的方法为诊断水基础设施在加速城市化和气候压力下的韧性提供了一种工具，有助于制定保护全球淡水资源的主动策略。

items.title: Human mobility-associated ambient PM2.5 differences and inequality in China
items.title_en: Human mobility-associated ambient PM2.5 differences and inequality in China
items.title_zh: 中国与人类流动相关的环境PM2.5差异及不平等现象
items.summary_en: Ambient PM2.5 conditions can differ between origins and destinations during both long-term migration and short-term population mobility, but the magnitude and heterogeneity of these differences remain unclear. Here we quantify migration- and mobility-associated differences in ambient PM2.5 concentrations in China using a nationally representative survey of ∼170 000 internal migrants and daily inter-city mobility flows derived from Baidu location-based services. We further examine socioeconomic associations using linear regression model. Overall, the survey-weighted mean origin–destination (OD) PM2.5 difference was −3.29 μg m−3, and 57.15% of migrants moved to destinations with lower PM2.5 concentrations. Migration-associated PM2.5 differences showed substantial heterogeneity by migration type, distance and household income, with moves to lower-PM2.5 destinations more common among inter-provincial, longer-distance and higher-income migrants. Regression models further showed that moving to economically stronger destinations did not necessarily correspond to more favorable PM2.5 differences. At the daily scale, mobility-associated OD PM2.5 differences shifted markedly during the Spring Festival travel season and followed a regular weekly cycle during non-holiday periods. These findings highlight the importance of considering mobility patterns and their heterogeneity when characterizing population distributions across different ambient pollution environments.
items.summary_zh: 无论是在长期迁移还是短期人口流动过程中，起始地与目的地之间的环境PM2.5状况可能存在差异，但这些差异的程度和异质性尚不明确。 本文利用一项针对约170 000名国内移民的全国代表性调查，以及基于百度位置服务数据得出的每日城际流动流量，量化了中国境内与移民及人口流动相关的环境PM2.5浓度差异。我们进一步采用线性回归模型分析了其与社会经济因素的关联。 总体而言，经调查加权后的起始地与目的地（OD）PM2.5 浓度差的平均值为 −3.29 μg m−3，57.15% 的移民迁往了 PM2.5 浓度较低的目的地。 与迁移相关的PM2.5差异在迁移类型、距离和家庭收入方面表现出显著的异质性，其中跨省迁移、长距离迁移和高收入迁移者更倾向于迁往PM2.5浓度较低的目的地。回归模型进一步表明，迁往经济更发达的目的地并不一定意味着PM2.5差异更有利。 在日尺度上，与人口流动相关的PM2.5源区-目的地差异在春节返乡高峰期间发生显著变化，而在非节假日期间则呈现规律的周周期。这些发现强调，在描述不同环境污染条件下的人口分布特征时，考虑人口流动模式及其异质性至关重要。

items.title: Emergent constraints improve near-term temperature projections over China: evaluations against observations based on the preindustrial baseline
items.title_en: Emergent constraints improve near-term temperature projections over China: evaluations against observations based on the preindustrial baseline
items.title_zh: 新兴约束条件提高了对中国近期气温预测的准确性：基于工业化前基准的观测数据验证
items.summary_en: Emergent constraints (ECs) are widely used to reduce uncertainties in climate projections, yet their reliability has rarely been evaluated against observations. We apply an established EC approach based on historical global surface air temperature trends and local residual warming trends to temperature change projections over China during 2006–2025 in the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project phases 5 and 6 (CMIP5/6) ensembles. Constrained projections exhibit smaller biases and reduced inter-model spreads relative to raw projections, with Taylor Scores increasing by 25.6% (8.5%), root-mean-square errors decreasing by 18.2% (18.2%), and inter-model spreads narrowing by 45.2% (52.0%) in CMIP5 (CMIP6). The improvements are more robust when referenced to 1850–1900 than to 1986–2005, associated with stronger emergent relationships and a smaller contribution of internal variability. These findings support the application of ECs to regional temperature projections and highlight the importance of baseline selection in enhancing the credibility of constrained temperature projections.
items.summary_zh: 突现约束（ECs）被广泛用于降低气候预测中的不确定性，但其可靠性鲜少通过观测数据进行评估。 我们采用一种基于历史全球地表气温趋势和局部残余变暖趋势的成熟EC方法，将其应用于耦合模式相互比较计划第5和第6阶段（CMIP5/6）集合中2006–2025年中国气温变化预测。 与原始预测相比，受约束的预测偏倚较小，模型间差异也较小：泰勒得分提高了 25.6%（8.5%），均方根误差降低了 18.2%（18.2%）， 模型间离散度缩小了45.2%（52.0%）（CMIP5/CMIP6）。 与1986–2005年相比，以1850–1900年为基准时，这些改进更为稳健，这与更强的涌现关系以及内部变异性的贡献较小有关。这些发现支持将约束条件（ECs）应用于区域温度预测，并突显了基准选择在提高受约束温度预测可信度方面的的重要性。

items.summary_en: Arctic winter sea ice could disappear much faster than scientists previously expected, according to new research using climate clues from 6,000 years ago. By comparing ancient ocean sediments with modern climate models, researchers found that future winter ice coverage may be roughly one million square kilometers smaller than earlier predictions suggested.
